comment: Add tested Vega-Lite semantics, diagnostics, filtered tooltips, recursive views, managed resources, and ranged rendering. Add onRenderCalloutPerDataPoint to GroupedVerticalBarChart, HeatMapChart and PolarChart, onRenderCalloutPerStack to GroupedVerticalBarChart, and identity-preserving onRenderCalloutPerPoint to ScatterChart. Preserve legacy Scatter all-values-at-x callbacks and null-to-default fallback; new point callbacks hide surfaces on null and use native defaults on undefined.
